Hello,

Thanks for reaching out to us.

At Tediber, we want to ensure you are completely satisfied with your purchase. That is why we offer a simple and free return policy:

Trial Periods

For products such as mattresses, bed bases, and sofas, you benefit from a 100-night trial period starting from the day of delivery.
For bed linen and protectors, the trial period is 30 days.
You also have a legal right of withdrawal of 14 days from the receipt of your order.

How to make a return

Contact us: You can start the process by sending an email to hello@tediber.com or by filling out our online return form. Please include a photo of the product to help us process your request.
Scheduling: For large items like mattresses or bed bases, a carrier will contact you to arrange a free pickup. For smaller items, we will provide you with a prepaid Chronopost return label.
Pickup/Drop-off: Returns are completely free of charge.
Refund: Once the item is received, we will process your refund to your original payment method, usually within 72 hours for large items and up to 15 business days for others.

Feel free to contact us anytime; we're here to help.
